notes: Read every source line (1-736). This is a pure data/types/config module (no JSX, no DOM, no runtime side effects); ported 1:1 to native-compatible TypeScript. The sole external dependency was `@/lib/icons` (web L11-12) which pulls lucide-react (React-DOM/SVG, not a native dependency) — see icon handling below. All other source content (types, category metadata, 67 command entries, and the embedded pure transform/buildParams/getDefaultValue functions) is preserved verbatim with no behavioral change.

L1-9 module doc comment preserved verbatim ('67 entries -> 72 commands (5 toggle pairs merged into single entries).'). An additional native-port note was appended to the header documenting the lucide->SemanticIconName strategy. L11-12 `import type { LucideIcon } from '@/lib/icons'` + `import { Icons } from '@/lib/icons'` -> replaced by `import type { SemanticIconName } from '../../../components/icons/SemanticIcon'` (relative depth verified: system/ -> features/ -> web-parity/ -> src/, then components/icons/SemanticIcon). lucide-react is NOT imported; no value-level `Icons` object is needed because every icon becomes a string literal SemanticIconName.

L14-104 types ported 1:1: CommandCategory union (14 members, L16-20), InputField (L22-31), InputConfig incl. transform/(value:string)=>unknown, fields, buildParams, getDefaultValue function-type signatures (L33-45), SelectOption (L47-52), SelectConfig (L54-57), CommandDef (L59-82), Vehicle (L84-93), VehicleState (L95-104), CommandLogEntry (L106-114). Only change: CommandDef.icon (web L67 `icon: LucideIcon`) and iconOff (web L68 `iconOff?: LucideIcon`) are re-typed to `SemanticIconName`; an inline comment records the rationale. All field names, optionality, and string-literal unions preserved byte-for-byte.

Icon conversion is a 1:1 identity rename `Icons.xxx` -> `'xxx'`. All 46 distinct concept keys used by the source (arrowDownToDot, arrowUpFromDot, battery, batteryFull, batteryMedium, calendarMinus, calendarPlus, charging, circleStop, climate, close, cooling, dog, doorOpen, download, eraser, error, flame, heart, home, keyRound, locate, location, locked, navigation, pencil, play, power, security, securityAlert, skipBack, skipForward, speaker, speed, speedCircle, tent, tirePressure, unlocked, userCheck, userPlus, userX, vehicle, volume, volumeLow, volumeOff, wind) are verified members of `SemanticIconName` (apps/native/src/components/icons/SemanticIcon), so each carries identical semantic intent and renders natively via <SemanticIcon name={cmd.icon} />.

L116-140 CATEGORY_ORDER (14 ordered categories, L118-123) preserved 1:1; CATEGORY_META Record<CommandCategory,{labelKey,fallback,icon}> (L125-140) ported with every labelKey, fallback string and icon re-typed to SemanticIconName: security->'security', climate->'wind', climate_protection->'securityAlert', charging->'charging', doors->'doorOpen', drive->'vehicle', windows->'wind', sunroof->'arrowUpFromDot', schedules->'calendarPlus', alerts->'speaker', navigation->'navigation', software->'download', vehicle->'vehicle', media->'play'.
